_comment: Project fidelity config for the SPX mobile HeroCard (Total Asset Card · 总资产卡片) master 619:8205. Tolerances/gate match cards/auth.
_checkTextContainerStyleNote: Opt-in: for each TEXT match, also compare the nearest styled-ancestor's bg/border. Catches container chrome drift (eye-pill missing gold fill, hero gradient drift) that the text-anchored diff is structurally blind to.
_fontAliasNote: Figma master labels the CJK family 'HarmonyOS Sans TC' (Traditional). The app correctly ships 'HarmonyOS Sans SC' (Simplified) for its zh_CN UI — same Huawei type family, correct script variant. Latin labels use the bundled PlusJakartaSans-*.

deviations.reason: Hero-card amount unit (USD suffix) — pure typeface-metrics drift. Figma master renders '≈ 8,540.97' in HarmonyOS Sans TC Bold at 120px wide; impl renders the IDENTICAL string in PlusJakartaSans-Bold at 128.25px (~8px wider — Latin numerals are slightly broader in Plus Jakarta Sans). The figma frame `Frame 2147225254` has gap=12 (matched 1:1 in impl), so USD's leading edge inherits the amount's actual rendered width: 24 + 128.25 + 12 = 164.25 vs figma's 24 + 120 + 12 = 156. Same physical layout (amount + 12 gap + USD), driven by the bundled font choice — not a HeroCard defect. Approved 2026-05-28.

iconDeviations.name: ^icon$
iconDeviations.reason: Inner iris sub-node of the balance eye — Figma exports the eye as outer-stroke + iris as two icon nodes. The impl renders the whole eye as one combined EyeMark SVG (react-native-svg, exported 1:1 from /tmp/ff-spx/icons/eye.svg), so the iris is not a separate <svg>. Same waiver shipped in the Cards module 2026-05-28. The eye glyph itself is gated normally — must pass on its own.

_iconDeviationsNote: Read by icon-diff.mjs: a matched icon's fail/warn is downgraded to `waive` (info) and excluded from `fails`. The outer-eye + iris geometry/box is still token-checked. The eye is NOT waived as a whole — this is a real EyeMark SVG upgrade (Feather glyph -> EyeMark SVG), it must pass on its own.
